title: PEDREF - Next-Generation Pediatric Reference Intervals
summary: A multi-center analysis of laboratory data to improve the interpretation of laboratory test results in children.
conditions: Laboratory test results performed during "routine" patient care.

interventions.name: We analyze all test results from children performed during clinical care to establish reference intervals for laboratory analytes with increased precision and accuracy.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
All children that underwent laboratory testing.
Exclusion criteria:
None.
